sources.description:
Eric Chou Portrait

Eric Chou appears in a formal black blazer over a white shirt, accessorized with a silver pendant necklace. His hair is neatly styled, and he gazes directly at the camera with a calm, confident expression against a simple light background.

This image complements an announcement that the Taiwanese singer-songwriter will perform at Arena Indonesia in Jakarta on May 9, 2026. He revealed plans to release a new album on March 10, 2026, blending R&B elements with his trademark ballads. sources.title: 周兴哲一周释出一MV 林柏宏、张钧甯跨刀演出 | Almost几乎是爱情 | 我们没开始 | Eric | 大紀元
sources.description:
周兴哲新专辑宣传肖像照

周兴哲身着黑色皮衣，面向镜头摆出沉稳表情，背景为简约棕色墙面，光线柔和地勾勒出面部轮廓与皮衣质感。这张专业肖像照用于宣传他出道10周年创作专辑《Almost几乎是爱情》中的第三支MV《我们没开始》。

该MV将于1月3日上线，由林柏宏和张钧甯主演，讲述心脏专科医师与天才作曲家之间的动人爱情故事。此前两支MV《想念你想我》和《永不结束的情人节》已累计数百万点击，专辑整体以浪漫爱情为主题。

Eric Chou’s Winter Portrait

His composed expression and the soft lighting accentuate the coat’s texture and the clean tailoring of his ensemble. The portrait conveys a quiet, introspective mood suited to autumn or winter fashion editorials.

The neutral color palette and minimalist setting focus attention on Chou’s features and the garment’s details. This studio shot highlights both the artist’s presence and the seasonal styling, making it ideal for promotional materials or fashion spreads.

Eric Chou stands against a deep red backdrop, wearing a tailored black blazer and a bold silver chain necklace. His composed expression and minimalist styling convey a modern, sophisticated image befitting the release of his tenth anniversary album.

The video’s narrative unfolds in a cooking class, exploring themes of longing and the bittersweet nature of almost-love, marking a milestone in Chou’s decade-long career

sources.description:
周興哲時尚宣傳照

周興哲以黑色皮衣搭配簡約飾品，於純白背景前擺出自信姿態，完美展現個人時尚風格。這張形象照強調了他的帥氣與潮流感，適合作為宣傳素材使用。

近期周興哲即將啟程澳洲，舉行《Odyssey旅程巡迴演唱會》雪梨站與墨爾本站，並推出翻唱A-Lin《摯友》的新版本。為慶祝出道十周年，他正徵集粉絲的感人愛情故事，入選者將有機會參與十年作品企劃並與他互動。

sources.description:
Eric Chou Portrait

Eric Chou is photographed seated on a wooden chair, positioned sideways against a solid green backdrop. He wears a black long-sleeve shirt and gray trousers, leaning forward with his arms draped over the chair’s backrest. The soft, natural lighting creates subtle shadows that accentuate his calm, introspective gaze.

Known for his emotionally resonant ballads like "以後別做朋友" and "你，好不好？," Chou has mastered crafting songs that offer listeners comfort and companionship. His minimalist portrait reflects the sincerity and focus he brings to his music, underscoring his status as a leading figure in Taiwan’s streaming era.

sources.description:
Eric Chou’s Epic Red Velvet Ensemble

Eric Chou wears a striking red velvet suit crafted by award-winning designer Hsu Li-wen, featuring draped shoulder panels that flow to the knees. This custom look continues the epic Odyssey tour theme, blending classical Greek and Roman elements to evoke a grand, cinematic atmosphere.

The singer-songwriter will perform at Taipei Arena for three nights beginning October 21, where he will debut his unreleased song “把你寫成我的歌” from the film soundtrack of "我吃了那男孩一整年的早餐". Fans will also see the exclusive finale of the “說太多” MV, making these concerts a unique live experience.

sources.description:
周興哲沉思宣傳照

周興哲以一襲白色西裝搭配黑色寬褲，站在深色背景前，右手輕撐下巴，展現沉穩自信的神情。銀色手錶與十字架項鍊為整體造型增添細節，襯托出他的成熟魅力。

這張照片可能用於宣傳他將於9月在台北小巨蛋舉辦的《台新銀行周興哲Odyssey旅程巡迴演唱會 台北返場》。作為他自2022年後再度回歸小巨蛋舞台的重要時刻，周興哲以簡潔俐落的造型，傳達出對新旅程的期待與自信。

sources.title: 周興哲出道12年自爆靈感枯竭　新歌遭退件3次「靠東京一台琴」神救援 | 中天新聞網
sources.description:
Eric Chou’s Reflective Portrait

Eric Chou stands confidently in a black leather jacket and pinstriped pants, set against a dark, minimalist background. His composed expression and modern styling convey both resilience and introspection.

After three rounds of revisions and creative block, Chou found inspiration on a hotel electronic keyboard in Tokyo. The resulting song “Shell,” created for the HBO series “Here’s Jin Lai,” uses the metaphor of past scars as protective shells to express growth and rebirth.
